oral.competencyBasis: Official page 1 covers both written and oral, including C2 prerequisites. It supplies areas, not numeric topic weights.
recommendedPriorityOrder: Motor control diagrams and fault reasoning
oral.excludedEvidence: Class B oral papers, solar T3 oral material, commercial revision advice and a third-party draft-guideline upload are not an authenticated C1 oral marking scheme.

groups.title: Kenyan licensing and documents
groups.gap: The certificate video uses a UK form. No dedicated Kenyan licence-scope, institutional-role, progression or current local forms walkthrough was found in the published course.
questionTitles: Who does what in the electricity sector?
Does licence tenure alone qualify you for A1?

groups.title: Generator principles and standby application
groups.gap: No single complete transfer installation and both-source commissioning demonstration; Kenyan authorisations are supported in the written bank rather than the UK equipment clips.
questionTitles: Generator load changes: governor and AVR
Why equipment has kVA and kW ratings

groups.title: C2 principles inherited by C1
groups.gap: C1 is not a replacement for C2. The lamp/heater variation also needs worked reasoning rather than simple definition recall.
questionTitles: Power, energy and the correct meter
A lamp in series with a heater

groups.title: AC and three-phase calculations
groups.verdict: Strong C1 foundation with written applications
groups.gap: Use the actual load connection and distinguish input kW, shaft output, kVA and kVAr; written numerical variants still require independent working.
questionTitles: Line and phase values in star and delta
Active power and a 32° phase angle

groups.title: Absolute/comparative resistance
groups.verdict: Core comparative principle; optional historical awareness
groups.gap: The Lorenz clip is a limited apparatus overview. No claim of a full numerical absolute-resistance course or of high written mark weight.

groups.title: Transformer action and calculations
groups.gap: Treat unreadable original numerical givens separately; the authored bank states its own complete training data.

groups.title: Wattmeters and CT calculations
groups.gap: One physical wattmeter successively measuring an unbalanced four-wire load is explained in the written answer, not demonstrated end to end by the analyser/two-wattmeter videos.
questionTitles: Measure power on a three-phase four-wire system

groups.title: Demand factors and load schedules
groups.verdict: Good methods; integrated answer practice needed
groups.gap: The domestic diversity example is optional context. The full mixed-PF office calculation needs a phase schedule and P/Q summation; no single selected clip reproduces the archived office task.
questionTitles: Demand, diversity, load factor and capacity factor

groups.title: Measured load, fixed bank and bills
groups.gap: Target-PF sizing is taught. No dedicated complete measured current → S/P/Q → fixed 100 kVAr bank → new PF/kVA → demand saving/surcharge worked video was established.
questionTitles: Measured transformer load and capacitor-bank savings

groups.title: Building single-line and riser drawings
groups.verdict: Good constituent teaching; partial exact task
groups.gap: No one video completes the specified floor-by-floor cold-store diagram or an entire four-storey design/protect/test/handover answer. Written project and authored SVG/answers bridge it.
questionTitles: Design, protect and verify a four-storey office

groups.title: Cables, containment and fault-energy selection
groups.gap: The connected seven-step examples are single-phase. Apply the subsequent three-phase examples and actual cable tables; a building description never by itself establishes a conductor size.
questionTitles: Select a cable from the installation conditions
Choose a wiring and containment system

groups.title: Final circuits and lighting effects
groups.verdict: C2 prerequisites plus C1 fault examples
groups.gap: The stroboscopic demonstration explains the hazard; it does not establish a complete industrial lighting mitigation design. Bathroom rules require applicable current requirements.

groups.title: Protection functions and switching
groups.verdict: Strong device foundations after Module 10; some specialist distinctions partial
groups.gap: Legacy voltage-operated ELCB terminology and metal-clad versus metal-enclosed terminology need the focused written answers; the optional MV lesson is outside the core C1 route.
questionTitles: Fuse, MCB, MCCB, ACB, RCD and RCBO

groups.title: Earthing, electrodes and loop acceptance
groups.verdict: Strong principles; electrode demonstrations remain in C2
groups.gap: A C1-only viewer can miss electrode testing. Local PME/customer intake details need the actual authorised supply arrangement; do not copy an arbitrary N–E link or a universal electrode-resistance figure.
questionTitles: Earth resistance versus earth-fault loop impedance

groups.title: Isolation, instruments, first aid and incidents
groups.verdict: Substantial C2/C1 teaching; practical competence unproven
groups.gap: Sectional isolation and first aid require demonstration and supervised practice. Incident-investigation clips do not establish current Kenyan statutory reporting procedures.

groups.title: Initial/periodic verification and judgement
groups.gap: There is a ring-result interpretation lesson, but no complete video assessing the whole archived mixed IR/earth/loop/missing-continuity schedule and deciding corrective action before certification.
questionTitles: Order of initial inspection and testing

groups.title: Motors, starting, protection and speed
groups.verdict: Strong direct coverage; integrated diagnosis/practical rehearsal needed
groups.gap: Learners must draw and explain circuits independently, including interlocks and no-voltage release. Stepper/servo basics are optional further study but appear in short written comparisons. An isolated winding test is not the complete non-starting-motor diagnosis.
questionTitles: DOL power circuit and holding circuit
Reverse a three-phase or split-phase motor
VFD speed control and four-quadrant operation
Induction, synchronous, stepper and servo motors
A motor hums but fails to run
Motor shaft power, efficiency and current
Pole count, synchronous speed and slip

groups.title: Power-factor correction and capacitance
groups.verdict: Strong foundation; some exact calculation variants partial
groups.gap: Target sizing and three-phase bank principles are taught. The historical single-phase µF cases, broad voltage-regulation options and full calculation chains also rely on authored worked answers/project; financial fixed-bank variants are mapped separately.
questionTitles: Causes and consequences of poor power factor
Bank connection, staging and source-side measurements
Voltage regulation and four improvement methods

groups.title: External lightning and SPDs
groups.gap: Model lightning-path and optional specialist material do not constitute a complete conventional building-system layout and installation demonstration. Practise the labelled schematic in the written bank.
